changes.newText: Superadmins can register specific images without rescanning a whole registry. Click Import Image to open the Import Image from Registry dialog, enter one full image reference per line — tag included — under Image references, choose the Architecture to look up, review the Images to import list, and click Import Image. An NVIDIA NGC catalog container URL can be pasted in place of a reference.

changes.newText: Superadmins can also refresh a single image's metadata from its registry with the Rescan action in the image's row.
